description: AI-powered text generation using Claude (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens (default 1000, served value capped at 4096). Credit cost is 20 plus 20 per 1,000 requested tokens above 1,000.

model.description: Explicit model; overrides mode. Accepts aliases claude, gpt/gpt4/gpt-4, gemini, grok (case-insensitive) or an exact id: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, grok-4.3, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning (retired gemini-1.5/2.0 and grok-2/3 names are remapped). Unknown models return 400. If omitted, mode decides (default smart = claude-sonnet-4-6).

name: ai-generate
